None of the 85 manifest entrypoints is one of these wrappers, so default FULL runs are not weakened, but a default pytest run of the acceptance tree reports skips, not failures, for the semantic oracle. check_architecture_debt_register.py exits 0 when the register file exists and contains the text DEBT- (L17-21): it cannot detect unresolved debt.
recommendation: ENT-AUDIT-X owner makes the semantic wrappers fail (or report SKIPPED_ENV) when the env gate is off in certifying modes; replace the debt gate by a content check of OPEN debt rows.

title: CHANGED-SINCE is fail-closed only for the audit tooling prefixes; a new product package path outside the impact map selects no mapped check (only the 31-id invariant floor runs)
affected_invariant: FRZ-EVOL-06 / FRZ-AUD-06 change-impact selection completeness
impact: _FAIL_CLOSED_PREFIXES lists only intergrax/platform/enterprise_audit/ and scripts/enterprise_audit/; selected_check_ids_from_impact simply unions prefix hits. Both CHANGED-SINCE dry-runs (planning pin: 68 of 85 checks planned; EVOL-X-era SHA: 80 of 85) and build_impact_map reported unmapped_paths = 0, but that count only covers the fail-closed prefixes. Static grouping shows 101 of 145 top-level census packages have no whole-package prefix in the JSON map or the PDC rules (the manifest-derived map adds entrypoint directories), so a change confined to such a package selects at most the invariant floor. Not exercised with a synthetic path (Campaign B).
recommendation: Campaign B: adversarial test with a brand-new package path; owner decides whether unmapped product paths should select FULL.

title: A non-certifying FAST run promotes PARTIAL to PASS (exit 0) when the only drift is TRACKED_DEBT
affected_invariant: FRZ-AUD-04 report honesty (PARTIAL must not read as PASS)
impact: runner.py L267-274: when the run is not certifying, the mode is FAST, the aggregate status is PARTIAL and every non-resolved drift has severity TRACKED_DEBT, status becomes PASS and the exit code CLEAN. The promotion is explicit and limited to non-certifying FAST runs, but a consumer that reads only the exit code sees a clean run while debt is outstanding.
recommendation: Owner reports the promoted state in the report header (not only the exit code).

title: 14 register or limitation entries have no owner (OWNER_MISSING)
affected_invariant: roadmap section 2.5 / debt register rules (every active exception or debt has an accountable owner)
impact: Entry-level scan of the consolidated registers: these entries name no owner and no owner column exists in their source register. Each entry is listed by ID in the finding scope (first 80).
recommendation: Register owners assign owners.

title: 405 OPEN or DEFERRED entries carry no severity (1298 entries analysed; mechanical limitation entries included)
affected_invariant: ARCH-FREEZE entry: unresolved architecture debt = 0 (needs severity and impact to be assessed)
impact: Of 1298 entries 405 are OPEN/DEFERRED with severity UNSTATED. The PDC gap register, DUP-X/EBH-6 hardcoding rows and the stage residuals have no severity or owner columns, so a mechanical OPEN count cannot be turned into a risk ranking without reading each row.
recommendation: Owners add severity and reopen conditions at the next register refresh.

title: 122 register entries state a currency that a source at the baseline contradicts (snapshot registers)
affected_invariant: registers must reflect the current state (roadmap section 2.4 evidence anchors; checklist update protocol)
impact: Reviewers marked these entries stale against the baseline (largest registers: PDC_GAP 64, ANNEX_F_GAP 20, HIST_REMAINING_BLOCKERS 11, HIST_STAGE_SHA 5, DIAG_GAP_LEDGER 4, EBH6_COND_REMEDIATION 4). Examples: the Annex F gap register (14 'No X' gaps contradicted by code), the PDC gap register P2 snapshot (63 rows resolved by P7/P8), FIND-FORMAL-B6, the EBH-6 conditional remediation register pinned to 202239f7. Staleness was judged by the reviewers from documents; E2.
recommendation: Owners regenerate or retire snapshot registers at the freeze SHA.

title: 45 obligation carry-forward chains are longer than one hop or end at a CLOSED / post-freeze stage ('bouncing obligations')
affected_invariant: roadmap section 2.5 (new blockers get an owner; do not skip forward)
impact: Graph of 1298 entries and 281 deferral edges extracted from the registers: 285 chains, 45 flagged. Examples: G1a-0001 -> G1a-0003 -> ARCH-FREEZE:T-B7-PROMOTE-DEBT (chain length >= 2); G1a-0001 -> G1a-0004 -> ARCH-FREEZE:T-B7-PROMOTE-DEBT (chain length >= 2); G1a-0001 -> G1a-0005 -> ARCH-FREEZE:T-B7-PROMOTE-DEBT (chain length >= 2); G1a-0001 -> G1a-0006 -> ARCH-FREEZE:T-B7-PROMOTE-DEBT (chain length >= 2). Graph edges come from the reviewers' carry_forward fields (E2).
recommendation: Owners confirm that each chain ends at a stage that owns the concern; the PDC-X D7 drain-seam chain (R014) is the clearest case.

title: 164 skip/xfail markers in qualification and architecture test trees are not in the EBH-7 skip disposition register; 15 markers carry no reason; no repo-wide N/A register exists
affected_invariant: FRZ N/A - WITH EVIDENCE rule; no known-red/skip without disposition
impact: Static scan of tests/ at the baseline: 691 skip-class markers ({'pytest.skip(': 259, 'pytest.mark.no_ci': 284, 'pytest.mark.skipif': 71, 'importorskip': 69, 'pytest.mark.xfail': 2, 'pytest.mark.skip': 6}). Of the 168 non-no_ci markers in qualification/architecture/security/tenant trees, 164 are in files that the EBH-7 skip disposition register (9 nodes, 5 files) does not cover (many are env-gated acceptance wrappers, see EQOA-A6 finding); 13 high-surface tests carry no_ci. 558 N/A decision mentions in 147 files exist without a register (only the EVOL-X deployment N/A register exists).
recommendation: Owner extends the skip register scope or classifies the categories (env-gated, optional dependency, no_ci).
